notes:
Lyrics and translations for 'Bella Ciao' are sourced from the historical, public-domain Italian partisan anthem; the English here was generated for this archive rather than taken from a published translation, so no third-party rights attach to it either.
The partisan words are anonymous. Under EU term law an anonymous work runs 70 years from first publication, and this text was first published in La Lapa in 1953, so it has been public domain since 1 January 2024 on even the most conservative reading.
